'''2010 Worlds Day 3 Aaron Kingery LS Hodur's Heroes''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Kingery]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 3).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers]]
* '''Username:''' Archmage
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
